quest.title: Ascension Challenge III
quest.description: The Genius Invokation TCG Society has determined that you are qualified for the Ascension Challenge. Win the Challenge and become a Master player! We hope you will have fun with Genius Invokation TCG!
quest.rewards_formatted: Lucky Coin x1000, Master Player Badge x1

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for the Ascension Challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow... (Hmm? Here for the Ascension Challenge? I see... You are indeed qualified for the challenge. Alright...)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: "I'll have Shuyun set up the challenge for you immediately. Do be careful!"

talks.objective: Finish Ascension Challenge duel with Prince

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow! (How wonderful! Congratulations on completing the Ascension Challenge. You're now a Master player!)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow. (Being a Master player means... that your technique has surpassed that of many people who have been studying the game. Those who don't put in enough effort will never be able to reach such level.)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (Of course, they fail to understand why we would spend so much time on a game that they just play for fun...)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow! (Should the players invited by you learn that you have obtained the title of Master, they will surely take games against you more seriously.)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (Perhaps some players are only willing to let you challenge the games set up by them after hearing that you have become a Master player... There are such strange guys in the tavern as well.)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (May the fun be with you in the world of Genius Invokation TCG!)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow... (How unfortunate... Try to be extra careful next time and perhaps make some adjustments to your deck before your next attempt.)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (I believe you are capable of completing this challenge.)
